'''Raptor Run''' was a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] course on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stend VI]]. It was once an [[Ordinance Detonation Test Area]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
